item: An interrupt at the rollup's checkpoint ends the build, a restart hands over how the last build ended, the panic wipe forgets the served counts
summary: Three small honest-status items. (1) _checkpoint, the one place the rollup's CHECKPOINT runs (the build's per-shard checkpoint, R169, and the final compact, R164), counted an InterruptException as a checkpoint that failed and carried on, so a stop asked for during it still aggregated every remaining shard; the aggregate and the bulk insert already propagated it (_NEVER_RETRIED). It now propagates. (2) The kept R172 record handed a restart the run of failures but not how the last build ended, so status() read consecutive_failures beside last_outcome null until the process built something; it now hands over last_outcome failed marked last_outcome_restored, cleared by this process's own first build. (3) A failed checkpoint that carries on is logged by class through _checkpoint's log_failure (already so; now pinned for the per-shard path). Item 38: panic_wipe calls served_cache.invalidate() beside kv_invalidate, so the wiped corpus's served counts and the status scans carried beside them are dropped. Red-without by four mutations.
